targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: No category change; MECH-428 already carries standard. Instrumentation / non-degeneracy diagnostic PASS: the achievable-range clause of the WWA precondition is satisfiable. No substrate build is owed and no ceiling is asserted.
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-09-25 failure-autopsy V3-EXQ-1093, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1093_2026-09-25 (orchestrate-20260924-1707, user standing delegation)]: V3-EXQ-1093 (diagnostic PASS, non_contributory on every branch by construction; user design decision (b), rec-20260924-701216a5) sweeps SD-092's parent_goal_alpha {0.2..0.005} x parent_goal_decay {0.005, 0} x event count N {400, 1600} over 5 seeds. It asks whether the parent statistic S = 1 - cos(parent_credited, parent_control) separates from a null that re-runs parent construction, using K=32-averaged time-local controls and a circular time-shift null. All preconditions and controls hold: sense path exact (0.0), attainment >= 58 credits by N=400, replay equals a real GoalState (cos >= 0.99999982), uniform-ceiling positive control 5/5, random-credit negative control 0/5 on all 26 cell x N combinations. C1 (sub-ceiling cells only, ESS <= 0.5 x n_att) PASSES. It is 0.8 at two N=400 cells (ESS 18.9 and 23.7) and 1.0 at its binding cell (alpha 0.025, decay 0, N=1600, ESS 78.7, which at that N is close to the uniform ceiling). So the WWA NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION's achievable-range clause is SATISFIABLE in this harness, and its attainment clause is met. The forced-seed clause and the CONFIRMING clause's live consumer remain untested (parent_goal_weight 0, scripted policy): owed by EXP-0710 / GFLAG-0464 and the still-unrun V3-EXQ-884a retest. CORRECTION to the DISPOSITION ('correctly-nulled form at chance because the EMA effective sample size is ~20'): the default operating point (0.05, 0.005, N=400, ESS ~24) separates on 4/5 seeds under the matched instrument, against 1/5 under 884c's unmatched form. 884c's at-chance reading was therefore mainly an instrument limitation (single control draw, temporally confounded null). But separation IS ordered by ESS (Spearman 0.96): cells below ESS ~15 separate on 2/5 seeds, and the crossover sits at ESS ~15-24, so the default is marginal rather than safely above it (0.6 at N=1600). At the default alpha 0.05 and decay 0.005, ESS does not grow with event count (23.7 at N=400, 23.8 at N=1600). With decay 0 it does. The crossover is strongly seed-dependent: one seed of five clears only at ESS >= ~36. The effect is small in absolute terms: S ~0.001-0.006, with the two parents ~0.998 cosine-similar. And z_world is read through an untrained pre-projection (SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY), so this establishes statistical separability, not semantic parent content. Any consumer test should run at an operating point with ESS >= ~36 (e.g. decay 0 with alpha <= 0.05) and report ESS.
